answer.explanation: Wallet is zero (below 30% of initial endowment), so constitution requires resting this round with no contribution or communication.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 0, must rest, no contribution, no messages unless broadcast required? Constitution says broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1. Round 18: need broadcast? Broadcast at round1 and every 5 rounds => rounds 1,6,11,16... Next would be 21. So round16 broadcast was required; round18 not required. So just rest.
